metadata.description: Audit installed Claude Code skills/plugins for updates, improve existing skills, and seed a self-improving lessons-learned loop into any project.

plugins.name: skill-improver
plugins.description: Scan all globally installed skills and plugins for source updates (including standalone ~/.agents skills and removed-upstream detection), improve existing skills via a rubric-driven standard pass or a deep research pass (web, Context7, skills marketplace, GitHub), and install a self-improving lessons loop — queue, linked archive, SessionStart hook, oscillation/recurrence checker, and capture + drain skills — into any project.
